events.title: Equinor Signs $1.8 Billion in Drilling Deals to Keep Oil and Gas Output High
events.body: Equinor extends $1.8 billion in drilling contracts with Baker Hughes, Halliburton, and SLB to sustain output on Norway’s continental shelf.
